svg.title: Tech stack as a directory tree. Core strengths: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Zod, Zustand, React Hook Form, tRPC, Prisma. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL; Frontend: React, Next.js, TanStack Query, TanStack Table, TanStack Router, Zustand, React Hook Form, Zod, i18next; UI & styling: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, MUI, Ant Design, Framer Motion; Mobile: React Native, Expo, NativeWind; Backend & API: Node.js, Fastify, tRPC, GraphQL (client), Better Auth, JWT; Databases: PostgreSQL, Prisma; Web testing: Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, MSW, Playwright; Mobile testing: Maestro; AI-assisted development: Cursor, Claude Code; DevOps & tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, Turborepo, pnpm, Vite, Vercel, Expo EAS, Git.
